editorial.blurb: Mazala Pizza brings bold Indian street food flavors to unexpected vessels—pizzas, tacos, and fries—in a small, welcoming River North spot that feels like a discovery.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Paneer Tikka Pizza and pair it with their masala chai; arrive before 10:30 pm when they're still serving, and don't skip the moti and garlic sauces that come with your pizza.
